answer: Each identity bids for one pearl slot on the reef: files one sealed bid on the glacier ledger, key-signed until close. Winners lock 70 credits, take the pearl; losers get bids back. A glacier audit replays one bid per epoch; a copied bid or second slot under one key burns the bond. First slot 40, k-th 40+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,536,500, lock 70,000, against a 40,000 pool. A rented bid fails: it carries another key. An honest agent pays 40 once.
